categories.main_business_segments: Ningbo Xianfeng New Material Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the building shading materials industry, focusing on the research, production, and sales of high polymer composite shading materials (sunlight fabrics) and shading finished products such as curtains and blinds. The company also engages in the manufacturing and sales of related industrial textiles and energy-saving window systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced polymer composite coating technologies, including high polymer composite coating formulations, single filament coating, multi-system co-extrusion coating, and heat setting technologies. These technologies enable the production of flame-retardant, UV-resistant, antibacterial, and environmentally friendly shading materials. The company holds numerous domestic and international patents and continuously innovates in product design and manufacturing processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's key customers include distributors and retailers primarily in the building and architectural sectors, with a significant portion of sales directed to overseas markets, especially Australia. End markets include commercial buildings, residential villas, public spaces like libraries and hotels, and industrial applications requiring energy-saving shading solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: Ningbo Xianfeng New Material operates mainly in China with a substantial export business, accounting for over 70% of revenue from overseas markets. The company has established subsidiaries and production bases in Singapore and Malaysia to support international expansion, particularly targeting Southeast Asia and mitigating trade risks with the US market.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of high polymer composite shading materials and finished shading products. It integrates upstream chemical and fiber composite technologies with downstream product assembly and distribution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include accelerating core technology breakthroughs, expanding product lines with high-performance and environmentally friendly materials, and developing new shading systems such as adjustable light curtains. R&D focuses on flame-retardant, degradable, and multifunctional composite materials, as well as enhancing product differentiation and sustainability to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of physical products, including polymer composite shading fabrics and finished shading products. The company operates primarily via offline sales channels, including direct sales to distributors and retail customers, with a significant portion of revenue derived from exports.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the domestic high polymer composite shading materials market, competing with foreign well-known manufacturers and a few domestic peers in the high-end segment. It benefits from first-mover advantages, strong technical capabilities, and brand recognition, while facing increasing competition from emerging domestic players in the mid to low-end market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 258.9 million, a 2.64% increase year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 9.7 million, showing a significant reduction in losses compared to prior years. The company maintains stable main business operations with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and technology innovation, despite challenges such as asset disposals and market fluctuations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ningbo Xianfeng New Material emphasizes its advanced polymer composite coating technology, product quality, and environmental sustainability as key differentiators. Its products offer superior energy-saving performance, flame retardancy, UV protection, and durability, meeting stringent national standards and customer customization needs. The company also provides integrated shading solutions and one-stop services, enhancing customer experience and market competitiveness.
